strictSamePath.explanation: Direct/bundle, compute/fullscreen, ordinary Forward+, and optimized-math parity use raw linear HDR agreement over all pixels plus display gates.

depthPrepassCoplanarTies.explanation: Only naive versus equal-depth prepass shading permits rare coplanar depth ties; this policy is not used for other same-path checks.

quantizedDeferred.explanation: Deferred variants encode albedo as UNORM8, normals as float16 or octahedral SNORM16, and compact variants reconstruct position from depth. Raw covered HDR and displayed output are both gated.
